fed.note: FOMC held the target range steady; dissenters Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack both wanted a 25bp hike. Chair Warsh called inflation "elevated" and said the Fed will cut the number of rate-setting meetings starting 2027.

catalysts.name: Roper Technologies, Inc.
catalysts.what: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $5.89 beat the $5.79 consensus on revenue +8% to $2.17B (7% organic); Roper raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $22.35–$22.40 from $22.15–$22.30 and guided Q4 adjusted EPS to $5.95–$6.00. Shares rose ~9.2% on the day while the Nasdaq-100 fell more than 2%.

catalysts.name: Vertiv Holdings Co
catalysts.what: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.21 beat the ~$1.82 consensus (revenue $4.31B, +61% y/y, also above the ~$3.75B consensus); Vertiv raised FY2026 guidance to ~$14.65B revenue (from $14.0B) and ~$7.15 adjusted EPS (from $6.65–6.75), citing accelerating AI data-center demand and organic orders more than doubling y/y. Shares rose as much as ~16–20% intraday.

ROP.what: Diversified technology company combining vertical software platforms with engineered products across industrial, medical and financial end markets.
